title: The Canon of the Adamant Body
summary: An Azorion canon on packing metal qi into bone and flesh until the body bears blows no mortal frame could, ending in the adamant body itself.

title: A Treatise on the Falling Blades
summary: An Azorion treatise on calling blades of metal qi out of the air in a descending flood, ending in the sword deluge.

title: The Lodestone Dominion
summary: An Azorion manual on commanding all the metal within a wide ring of the cultivator's reach, ending in a pull no iron resists.

title: A Manual of the Wrought Host
summary: An Azorion manual on forging armed figures of metal qi that fight at the cultivator's side, ending in the whole wrought host.

title: The Compendium of the Piercing Star
summary: An Azorion compendium on drawing metal qi to one bright needle-point that no armor turns, ending in the skyneedle.

title: Monarch Rules of the Hundred Rings
summary: Gives a Monarch the hundred concentric rings of metal qi that guard, bind and cut, ending in the binding rings.

title: The Gale Treatise on the Razor Wind
summary: A Gale treatise on riding the wind with a blade of metal qi so that the cut arrives before the sound, ending in the razor gale.

title: Compendium of the Fighting Chains
summary: A Gale compendium on living chains of metal qi that coil, strike and drag, ending in the serpent chain.

title: The Bell That Rings the Body
summary: A Gale manual on turning the body into a great bell whose single ring shatters what stands before it, ending in the bellshock.

title: A Manual of Quicksilver Tempest
summary: A Gale manual that lifts liquid metal into a roaring storm of silver, ending in the mercury tempest.

title: Course of the Lodestar Grasp
summary: A Gale course in the grasping pull of a lodestar over every blade and bolt about the cultivator, ending in the lodestar grasp.

title: Monarch Bearing of the Last Edge
summary: Gives a Monarch the held stillness and single flawless cut of metal qi, ending in the final edge.
